response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS mean_mi FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), status_avgs AS (SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mi FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rfistat), qualifying AS (SELECT s.rfistat, s.avg_mi FROM status_avgs s, overall o WHERE s.avg_mi > o.mean_mi) SELECT q.rfistat, q.avg_mi AS avg_modindex, q.avg_mi - o.mean_mi AS above_average_by, q.avg_mi - (SELECT AVG(avg_mi) FROM qualifying) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM qualifying q, overall o;
